newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Helsinki bourse plan rejects Nordic co-op - Swedes.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki bourse plan rejects Nordic co-op - Swedes.

text.p: The Helsinki Stock Exchange in its plans for a new information and trading system has effectively rejected closer cooperation between Nordic exchanges, a Stockholm Stock Exchange official said on Tuesday.
The Helsinki Stock Exchange said earlier it had chosen a new trading and information system to be supplied by Australian Computershare Systems Pty Ltd and introduced in the first half of 1998.
"This is what we have heard today," Stockholm Stock Exchange Deputy Chairman Carl Johan Hogbom told Reuters.
"We cannot interpret this as anything else than meaning thumbs down to the Nordic cooperation we have been striving after for several years," he said.
